fields.Name: Preprocessing
fields.Description: Root of the transform space: fit-once/apply-everywhere operations on feature columns.
fields.Story: Preprocessing is the quiet half of every model: what was filled, scaled, encoded and clamped before anything learned.

fields.Name: Missing Values
fields.Description: Transforms that decide what absence means before a model sees the column.
fields.Story: A blank is not a zero; these components make the difference explicit instead of accidental.

fields.Name: Impute
fields.Description: Fill missing values by mean/median/mode/constant; fitted at train time, replayed at scoring.
fields.Story: Standing in for the unknown with the least-surprising value the training data offers.

fields.Name: Presence
fields.Description: Emit a <col>__present mask and, optionally, keep the column MISSING rather than coercing absence to 0.
fields.Story: Records that we did not know, so that not knowing can count for something instead of quietly reading as a zero.

fields.Name: Scaling
fields.Description: Population-relative rescaling; parameters are fit on the training population and frozen.
fields.Story: Scaling puts every signal on a comparable footing so no input dominates by unit accident.

fields.Name: Standardize
fields.Story: Measures each value in standard deviations from what is normal for the population.

fields.Name: Min-Max
fields.Description: Rescale to [0,1] by the training min/max. Ported from Sonar.
fields.Story: The simplest normalization there is: where does this value sit between the smallest and largest we have seen?

fields.Name: Percentile
fields.Description: Rank-based normalization with midpoint tie handling. Ported from Sonar.
fields.Story: Ignores magnitudes entirely and asks only: what fraction of the population does this value beat?

fields.Name: Z-Score Clamped
fields.Description: Z-score clamped to ±3σ and mapped to [0,1]. Ported from Sonar.
fields.Story: Standardization with guard rails: outliers stop mattering more than three standard deviations out.

fields.Name: Encoding
fields.Description: Categorical/numeric encodings fit on the training vocabulary.
fields.Story: Encoders translate categories and ranges into the numbers a model can reason with.

fields.Name: One-Hot
fields.Description: Expand a categorical column into indicator columns; vocabulary frozen at train time.
fields.Story: Gives every category its own switch instead of pretending categories have an order.

fields.Name: Bin
fields.Description: Discretize a numeric column into fitted bins.
fields.Story: Turns a continuum into a handful of named ranges a human can also reason about.

fields.Name: Curve Mapping
fields.Description: Stateless, parameterized value→value curves (no population fit). Ported from Sonar.
fields.Story: Hand-shaped curves that encode judgment — how quickly goodness saturates, where the cliff is — without any training.

fields.Name: Logistic Curve
fields.Description: Sigmoid mapping with operator-set midpoint and steepness.
fields.Story: An S-curve that says: change near the midpoint matters, change at the extremes does not.

fields.Name: Banded
fields.Story: Judgment as a staircase: these ranges are bad, these fine, these excellent.

fields.Name: Lookup
fields.Description: Exact-match table with a fallback value.
fields.Story: The bluntest possible meaning function: this value means exactly this, everything else means that.
